The coset uQ and the sign of (-1/p) classify peak maxima and equality; the quadratic Gauss evaluation gives I=2(p-2)+2 Re(G_p(u)). All boundaries p=3 and p=5 are covered; direct independent computations for 2268 site/root configurations corroborate but do not replace the analytical proof.
